observations.behavior: Adds a migration that removes the FK constraint and its index on warehouse external data job rows, and explicitly drops the index concurrently.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion workflows to proceed without blocking reads/writes during a user account deletion, while retaining the FK relationship. The migration also removes the index to avoid a sequential scan on the warehouse table during the user deletion, which could otherwise degrade warehouse ingestion performance.
